API ReferenceZscaler Private Access APIEmergency Access ManagementActivates the emergency access user for the specified customer.
Activates the emergency access user for the specified customer.
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/emergencyAccess/user/:userId/activate

Activates the emergency access user for the specified customer.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

userId
string
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the emergency access user.

QUERY PARAMETERS
sendEmail
boolean

Indicates if the email is sent from the IdP to the user.

Default value: false
microtenantId
int64

The unique identifier of the microtenant of ZPA tenant. For Default microtenant 0 should be passed and for Customer data microtenant should be null.

Responses
​
200
400
401
403
404
405
409
415
500
503

OK
